QuestInfo.name: [Lunar New Year Mission] Deliver Luminous's Message
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Luminous again to get the finished message.
QuestInfo.1: Luminous's message is for #bLania#k in #bEllinia#k. You can sense his deep affection for her in every word he speaks. The one protecting Lania's house will meet you #bClose to the Birds#k in #bEllinia#k. You should head there now.
QuestInfo.2: You delivered the message to #bLania#k. She's certain she will meet him again soon enough and asked you to tell him she'll wait for him.

default.0: The one protecting Lania's house will meet you #bClose to the Birds in Ellinia#k.
